mapper.select:
SELECT s.trade_id, s.title, s.price_point, s.thumb_img, s.recommend_cnt, s.regdate, m.nickname AS seller_nickname, t.toplct_id, t.toplct_name, c.item_ctg_name FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id JOIN top_location t ON s.toplct_id = t.toplct_id JOIN saletrade_item_category c ON s.item_ctg_id = c.item_ctg_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 'N'
AND s.item_ctg_id = #{itemCtgId}
AND ( s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.item_ctg_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.toplct_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY s.trade_id DESC

SELECT s.*,
-- 판매자 정보 m.userid AS seller_userid, m.nickname AS seller_nickname, m.email, m.profile_img,
-- 카테고리명 c.item_ctg_name
FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id
JOIN saletrade_item_category c ON s.item_ctg_id = c.item_ctg_id
WHERE s.trade_id = #{tradeId} AND s.is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT trade_id, title, thumb_img, price_point FROM saletrade_board WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND trade_id != #{tradeId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY trade_id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommend r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id WHERE r.board_type = 'SALE' AND r.board_id = #{tradeId} AND m.userid = #{userid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommend ( member_id, board_type, board_id ) SELECT m.member_id, 'SALE', #{tradeId} FROM member m WHERE m.userid = #{userid}
INSERT INTO trade_history ( trade_id, buyer_id, seller_id, used_point, earn_point, used_mileage ) VALUES ( #{trade_id}, #{buyer_id}, #{seller_id}, #{used_point}, #{earn_point}, #{used_mileage} )

INSERT INTO saletrade_board ( seller_id, title, content, price_point, max_mileage_use, quantity, thumb_img, item_ctg_id, toplct_id, detail_address, allow_full_mileage, status, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{seller_id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{price_point}, #{max_mileage_use}, #{quantity}, #{thumb_img}, #{item_ctg_id}, #{toplct_id}, #{detail_address}, #{allow_full_mileage}, 'S', 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE saletrade_board SET is_deleted = 'Y', deleted_at = NOW() WHERE trade_id = #{trade_id} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM saletrade_board WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY regdate DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE saletrade_board SET is_deleted = 'Y', deleted_at = NOW() WHERE trade_id = #{trade_id} AND seller_id = #{seller_id} AND status = 'C'
mapper.select: SELECT trade_id, seller_id, title, content, price_point, max_mileage_use, quantity, thumb_img, detail_img, item_ctg_id, recommend_cnt, status, regdate, updatedate, toplct_id, detail_address, allow_full_mileage FROM saletrade_board WHERE trade_id = #{tradeId} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.update:
UPDATE saletrade_board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, price_point = #{price_point}, max_mileage_use = #{max_mileage_use}, quantity = #{quantity}, thumb_img = #{thumb_img}, item_ctg_id = #{item_ctg_id}, allow_full_mileage = #{allow_full_mileage},
status = 'S'
WHERE trade_id = #{trade_id} AND seller_id = #{seller_id} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT s.trade_id, s.title, s.price_point, s.thumb_img, s.regdate, s.thumb_img, m.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY s.regdate DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.trade_id, s.title, s.price_point, s.thumb_img, s.recommend_cnt, s.thumb_img, m.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY s.recommend_cnt DESC, s.trade_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recent_view (member_id, trade_id) VALUES (#{member_id}, #{trade_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT rv.viewed_at, sb.trade_id, sb.title, sb.price_point, sb.thumb_img, sb.status FROM recent_view rv JOIN saletrade_board sb ON rv.trade_id = sb.trade_id WHERE rv.member_id = #{member_id} ORDER BY rv.viewed_at DESC LIMIT 20
